inspiration.observed_pattern: A JSON_TABLE NESTED PATH expands child objects into multiple rows while repeating a parent scalar column.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored shipment object with two item objects. The minimized query isolates nested child-row expansion, parent-value repetition, and typed child projection.

fixture_notes: One shipment contains two fixed items, so NESTED PATH must emit two rows with the same shipment code and distinct typed quantities.
determinism_notes: The JSON document and item order are fixed, and output is ordered by SKU with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.

steps.sql: SELECT jt.shipment_code, jt.sku, jt.quantity FROM JSON_TABLE('{"shipment":"S-900","items":[{"sku":"A-1","quantity":2},{"sku":"B-7","quantity":3}]}', '$' COLUMNS (shipment_code VARCHAR(16) PATH '$.shipment', NESTED PATH '$.items[*]' COLUMNS (sku VARCHAR(16) PATH '$.sku', quantity INT PATH '$.quantity'))) AS jt ORDER BY jt.sku
